PB46-006.name: Den-O Belt
PB46-006.effect:
When this card is revealed from the deck by your "Den-O"/ "DenLiner"/ "Taros" effect, you can add it to the Hand.

[Mirage: Cost 2 ([White Core])]
[During Set] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per Turn: Same Name) You can put one of your "Taros" Braves onto the Removed Zone. After this effect resolves, you can [Contract Advent] a "Den-O" from your Hand, treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[Main]
(Once per Turn: Same Name) Deploy a "Den-O"/"DenLiner" from your Trash. Then, if you don't have a Mirage set, you can set this card.

PB46-008.name: Kamen Rider Ark One［2］
PB46-008.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Zero-One" & C6 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

This card/Spirit is also treated as "Zero-One".

When your Green Spirits/ "Izu" Grandwalker Nexuses are depleted/destroyed by the opponent and sent to the Trash, you can [Contract Advent] this card from the Hand, treating [Soul Core] as being sent to the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
Once per turn, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. For each Spirit card among them, send a core from any opposing Spirits to the Reserve. Add the revealed cards to the Hand.

PB46-002.name: Kamen Rider Den-O Ax Form ［2］
PB46-002.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Kamen Rider Den-O" & C2 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Your counter +1. Then, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate to the deckbottom.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2]
All your "Den-O", and all your "Taros" Braves can't be destroyed by opposing effects.

PB46-X01.name: Kamen Rider Den-O Climax Form ［2］
PB46-X01.effect:
While you have ten counters or more, for each "Taros" in your Removed Zone, this card in Hand/Removed Zone gets -1 cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can summon up to two "Taros" from your Hand/Removed Zone, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit can brave with up to four White Braves, and while braved to four Braves, this Spirit is unaffected by opposing effects.

[During Brave] [LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each Brave this Spirit has, return an opposing Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus to the deckbottom.

PB46-003.name: Kamen Rider Den-O Gun Form ［2］
PB46-003.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Kamen Rider Den-O" & C2 or more, (Either Attack Step)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Your counter +1. Then, you can return an opposing Burst to the deckbottom.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Once per turn, at the end of battle, this Spirit can refresh.

PB46-X02.name: Kamen Rider Den-O Liner Form ［3］
PB46-X02.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Kamen Rider Den-O" & C6 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Advents/Attacks)
You can put a "Den-O"/"Taros" from your Hand/Trash onto the Removed Zone. When you've done so, you can return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
By returning a "Taros" from your Removed Zone to the deckbottom, activate one of the [During Brave] (When Attacks) effects written on that card as this Spirit's effect, ignoring [During Brave]. After that effect resolves, this Spirit refreshes.

PB46-004.name: Kamen Rider Den-O Rod Form ［2］
PB46-004.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Kamen Rider Den-O" & C1 or more, (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Among them, put every "Taros" to the Removed Zone. Discard any remaining cards.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2]
You can add a "DenLiner" revealed from deck by this Spirit's effect to the Hand.

PB46-001.name: Kamen Rider Den-O Sword Form ［4］
PB46-001.effect:
Flash - [Contract Advent: "Kamen Rider Den-O", (Your Turn)]
By sending your [Soul Core] to the Trash, stack this from the Hand onto your target Spirit.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Advents)
Your counter +1, and put a core from the Void to any of your Spirits.

[During OC] [LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit to the deckbottom.

PB46-007.name: Kamen Rider Kuuga Ultimate Form (Dark Eyes Ver.)
PB46-007.effect:
Flash - (Either Attack Step)
If you have three counters or more, by discarding this card from your Hand, discard up to three cards from your decktop. When this "Deck-Discarding effect" discards any "Kuuga", summon this card by paying one cost. When you've done so, you can summon/deploy a "Kuuga" from your Hand.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned/Attacks)
You can destroy an opposing Spirit/Nexus with two symbols or less, and when destroys, (Once per Turn: Same Name) besides the [Soul Core], you can send up to three cores from your Trash to any "Kamen" family Spirits.

PB46-005.name: The Time Train, DenLiner
PB46-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Turn)
(Can't Stack) When the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect, you can reveal a card from your decktop. If that's "Den-O", you can add it to the Hand; If that's "Taros", you can put it onto the Removed Zone. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
Once per turn, you can summon a "Taros" Brave card from your Removed Zone by paying one cost.

PB46-CX01.name: Here I Am! Kamen Rider Den-O
PB46-CX01.effect:
While this card is in Soul State, you can [Contract Advent] onto it. When you do, you can put any number of cores from your Field/Reserve to the advent card.

[Soul State] [Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (Start of Your Attack Step)
(Can't Stack) You can return a "Den-O" with [Contract Advent] from your Trash to the Hand.

[Contract Pre-Advent]/[Spirit] [LV1][LV2] (When Summoned/Attacks)
Your counter +1. Then, you can reveal two cards from your decktop. Among them, put a "Taros" to your Removed Zone. Discard any remaining cards.
